description: C5 control (Phase 1 plan, run after Phase 7): QSTL with the MSE loss (E6) and with the SWAP-test fidelity loss (E3) on the same shared SPSA learning-rate grid, the same 10,000 epochs (the paper's MSE budget), shots, perturbation, data (raw AAPL, GOOGL) and seeds. Purpose: separate the effect of the loss from the 1e4 learning-rate difference in the paper (MSE lr 1e-5, fidelity lr 0.1). Grid = Phase 1 grid {1e-5, 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1} plus 1.0 (amendment declared before the runs). Evaluation matrix; the best learning rate per loss is chosen on the training metric only.

evaluation.split: train target (the paper's protocol for Fig. 17); test = chronological last 20 % for the secondary log-loss
evaluation.aggregation: mean and sample standard deviation over seeds; paired-by-seed differences with a 95 % t interval
evaluation.tie_rule: a paired difference whose 95 % interval contains 0 is reported as not distinguishable
evaluation.selection_rule: per loss, the learning rate with the lowest seed-mean output/train/kl_joint per asset (training metric only; no test data)
